     Lottery | [_] Lottery Member No. 03 (Pot-lover Macken)
             |
   Valuables | [_] Emigre Manuscript
_____________|_________________________________________________________________
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Make your way back to the Orphanage in London. Go into the room where you
fought Jack and Mammon, and talk to the little boy, Insolent Jean. He wonders
if you want to play with him and his friends.

——————————————————————————————
   [1] Alright, we'll play.
   [2] I'm busy.
——————————————————————————————

Choose 1 and you'll start playing. You have one minute to find all of his
friends, so quickly each of the 5 rooms here to find 4 children: the room
you're currently in with Insolent Jean, the large hallway, the top-right room,
the top-left room, and the bottom-left room. There's only one kid in each room,
and their locations will be random, so it may take two or three tries to find
them all. You must also return to Insolent Jean and talk to him before the
timer runs out to succeed.

Once you've won, you'll be able to go past him. Climb the stairs and examine
the pot, and you'll receive the [_EMIGRE MANUSCRIPT_] from Pot-lover Macken. As
with the Books of Rituals, examine the Emigre Manuscript in your Valuables
menu, and it'll unlock the Cave Temple on your World Map (the Britain Map,
specifically) the next time you're out there.

After you receive the Manuscript, go out into the hallway and SAVE. Then go
back in and talk to Pot-lover Macken once more, and you'll find out that he's a
Lottery Member!

           _________________________________________________________
           \$$$$ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ $$$$/
            \              [_LOTTERY MEMBER NO. 03_]              /
             \___________________________________________________/
              \¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯/
               \           (Red)  |  Crucifix                  /
               /        (Yellow)  |  Seal of Wisdom            \
              /      (Turquoise)  |  Pure Extract               \
             /           (Green)  |  Pure Root                   \
            /            (White)  |  Tissues                      \
           /$$$$ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _|_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ $$$$\
           ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

The ring here is INVISIBLE, so make sure to equip the Pocket Watch so you can
see it, which then becomes the easiest Lottery of the game. Little brat....
Anyway, make sure to win the Crucifix before continuing on; you already have
one, but since it cancels out all status effects, you'll definitely want a
second! If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again. Remember, you
need to win something from each member at least once!

That's it for here. On to the next quest!
